changeSet.author: aaltynbek

preConditions.onFailMessage: The 2026 overdue rules group must have exactly one current version
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM stop_factors.stop_factor_group WHERE valid_to IS NULL AND change_reason = 'Правила по просрочкам 2026'

preConditions.onFailMessage: Metric #10 must be the overdue bucket count
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM stop_factors.stop_factor_metric WHERE id = 10 AND calculator = 'OVERDUE_BUCKET_COUNT'

preConditions.onFailMessage: The MSB overdue factors for months 13-24 are already there
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM stop_factors.stop_factor f JOIN stop_factors.stop_factor_group g ON g.id = f.group_id WHERE g.valid_to IS NULL AND g.change_reason = 'Правила по просрочкам 2026' AND f.order_number BETWEEN 28 AND 31
